svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each entry checked against an index (agent); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner: outline and argument map (agent); Literature strategist: the sections with no source (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Outline approval (stop).
